        buy Kurtas Online

        Get Creative with Womens Kurtas

        Women are always on the search for variety in Indian wear to put together stylish and stunning looks. To that end, womens kurtas allow a lot of versatility. They are great for daily use and are good enough for festivals also.

        It is possible to buy womens kurtas at different prices which makes them a practical selection. So keep reading to know about which are the styles you should own.

        Every Kurta for Ladies that is a Must-Have for You

        When it comes to womens kurtas, there is plenty of variety. So we have narrowed the options down to help.

      • Solid - No collection of womens kurtas is complete without at least a few that are plain. You could go for intense shades or pastel hues depending on your mood. They do well with heavy jewellery or minimal pieces. The best part is that knee-length ones can be paired with jeans too.
      • Floral - This kind of kurta for women is a universal favourite as they are not only easy to wear regularly but also have a unique softness about them. You can use one with a curved hem that is ankle length to wear with a pair of palazzo pants, juttis and kajal to complete the look.
      • Embellished - India is a country of many festivals, so having a couple of such womens kurtas is a wise idea. You can easily find one with tread work, glass, sequin, tassels and more to suit your personal preferences. Now all you need are a pair of leggings and strappy heels.
      • Colour-blocked - Such womens kurtas are an easy way to play with contrasting or complementing colours in a single garment. There could be anywhere from two to three shades in a colour-blocked womens kurta. The key here, however, is to go easy on the accessories.

        • Easy Styling Tips for Womens Kurtas

        No matter which type of womens kurtas you prefer wearing these tips will inspire you to style them.

      • Ankle Length - If you want to give a gown-like, flowing effect, then this is the kind of womens kurtas to select from. You can opt for straight cut, Anarkali, A-line or layered options. You can pair them with palazzo pants, hoop earrings and block heels.
      • Calf Length - This is the classic choice when it comes to womens kurtas and are always in vogue There are long-short, straight or curved hemlines to pick from. For an easy, everyday look wear them with leggings, flat strappy sandals and a hint of kajal.
      • Above Knee - These are the womens kurtas that will bring a contemporary feel to your ensemble. They can be used as ladies dhoti kurtas or also worn with fitted cropped jeans. With a solid coloured piece, you can opt for white sneakers and a denim jacket.
